events.title: Morbid Anatomy’s Krampus Market
events.description:
Join us for a delightfully non-traditional holiday market inspired by Krampus, the cloven-hoofed sidekick of St Nicholas who, in some parts of Europe, is infamous for mayhem and mischief during the Christmas season! Over twenty of our favorite vendors will showcase an exciting and unusual array of antiques, taxidermy, artisanal fashion, handmade jewelry, original art, gothic home decor, new and vintage books, and more. Find something for that hard-to-shop-for person on your list, and—if you’re lucky!—come home with something for yourself. But if you’ve been naughty this year, you’d better beware of Krampus and his birch branches!
We are delighted to offer special early access free to Patreon members ($15+)— enjoy exclusive first access to the market. After 11am, doors open to all shoppers for just $5.
There will also be opportunities to stop by our prize wheel for a spin and visit our Library for a look at the collection and special activities!
We look forward to seeing you!

events.title: Faces In Color | An Oil Portrait Workshop
events.description:
Explore how a few carefully chosen colors can bring a face to life.
This approachable introduction to portrait painting begins with a front-facing reference and a limited palette. We’ll break the face into simple shapes, explore basic proportions and feature placement, and learn how light and shadow give a portrait its depth.
Artist Kristina Dubrovskaia will guide you step by step, helping you mix colors, build light and dark areas, and develop an expressive portrait study. You’ll receive individual feedback throughout, with space to experiment and make your own color choices.
You’ll leave with a small oil portrait study and a clearer understanding of how to begin painting a face.
All materials and references are provided. Beginners and painters with some experience are welcome.

events.title: Fall Holiday Market at Barrow’s Intense
events.description:
Get a head start on holiday shopping at the Fall Holiday Market at Barrow’s Intense!
Join us on Saturday, November 14, from 12–6 PM in Industry City’s Courtyard 5/6 for an afternoon celebrating Brooklyn and NYC’s independent artists, designers, makers, and specialty food producers.
Shop a thoughtfully curated selection of handmade gifts, original artwork, jewelry, accessories, artisanal foods, and one-of-a-kind finds while enjoying craft cocktails from Barrow’s Intense and delicious food from @better_than_porridge.
Meet the makers behind the products, discover unique gifts, and enter our holiday raffle with a complimentary raffle ticket for every purchase from participating vendors.
Free admission. All ages welcome. Walk-ins encouraged!
Follow along as we announce our participating vendors and share sneak peeks of what’s coming.
Hosted at Barrow’s Intense | Curated by Pop-ups NY

events.title: Industry City Gourmet Food and Drinks Tour
events.description:
Set against the iconic backdrop of Sunset Park’s historic waterfront, the massive, revitalized structures of Industry City form a breathtaking stage for an exclusive culinary journey. This premium food and cocktail tour is a curated exploration of taste and craft, transforming an evening into a memorable, high-end experience.
Your adventure begins with artistic bonbons at Lilac Chocolates, explores gourmet imports at Sahadi’s, and includes a refined whiskey tasting at Fort Hamilton Distillery, followed by a sophisticated sake flight. Savor additional artisanal discoveries within the awe-inspiring industrial halls.
Perfect as a distinctive date night, this tour is also fully customizable for private groups and corporate retreats. We specialize in tailoring this engaging experience for team-building and client entertainment, making it an ideal one-day corporate outing. A sophisticated mini-vacation for locals and a profound discovery for visitors.
events.vendor: Industry City Gourmet Food and Drinks Tour

events.title: MILNA MARKET: South Asian Pop-Up Market NYC
events.description:
The wait is finally over! Milna Market is back at Industry City on November 15 🍂
​Milna Market is a curated South Asian pop-up market in NYC, transforming 11,000 sq ft into a modern bazaar featuring 60+ South Asian brands and makers across food, fashion, jewelry, beauty, home, lifestyle, and more.
​In Hindi, milna means both “to meet” and “to find,” which is exactly what the market is all about. Join us for a full day of community, discovery, and shopping South Asian-owned businesses!
​🎟️ $4 Entry (plus tax)
Guests under 12 and over 65 receive free admission.
​Refund Policy: Tickets are non-refundable unless the event is canceled by the Organizer.
​🎉 We will have carrom, henna, and more activities!
​🎁 The first 25 attendees will receive a FREE Milna Market Mini tote!
​🛍️ Our Mini Totes are also available to preorder for pickup only at Milna Market on November 15. Select the Milna Market Mini Tote option in the Luma ticket section to purchase yours! Totes can be picked up at the first-floor check-in area.

events.title: Sake Tasting Event: Sake and Cheese Pairing Class and Brewery Tour
events.description:
Step away from that bottle of vino and join us to sample the absolute best beverage to pair with cheese – We are talking about sake! If you haven’t yet tried pairing craft sake and premium cheese, you are in for a revelation. We’ll explore a wide range of flavors and textures… and together, we’ll discover the most exciting combinations of sake styles and cheeses from around the world. The experience is fun, interactive and absolutely delicious! Join us at Brooklyn Kura to learn about sake where sake is made!
What’s included:
A welcome sake to get you started!
A brief intro to sake and cheese basics.
Guided Tasting of 5 Japanese craft sakes from different regions paired to perfection with 5 outstanding cheese varieties.
Exploration of sake and cheese production styles and terrior.
Enjoy some nibbles and spreads on your cheese board that will take the pairing over the top.
Handouts so you can bring your newfound sake and cheese knowledge home
Finish with a Guided tour through our new Sake Brewery
